description_en: Invoke this API to import external data into the IoT Platform. Data imported into the IoT Platform through this API is referred to as data from an API data source. You can upload data from your local environment or other platforms to the IoT Platform for data analysis and processing.
description_zh: 调用该接口向物联网平台导入外部数据。通过此API导入物联网平台的数据，称为API数据源的数据。您可将本地或其他平台的数据上传至物联网平台，用于数据的分析和处理
kebab_example: aliyun iot add-data-for-api-source --iot-instance-id iot-0pp1n00000 --api-id cxatswiniekxw000 --content key_:_value_,_ts_:1637658200000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDataForApiSource

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify it.  

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The data content uploaded to the IoT Platform, in JSON format.  
The JSON must contain the **ts** field, which represents the timestamp (in milliseconds since the UNIX epoch) when the data was generated.
parameters.description_zh:
上传到物联网平台的数据内容。JSON格式。
JSON中必须包含**ts**字段，用来表示数据产生的时间点（unix 毫秒精度的时间戳）。
